title: Teach cell-authoring pre-flight: constraint checklist plus mandatory dry-run before cells add
action: In skills/bee-planning/references/planning-reference.md, insert a compact 'Pre-flight before cells add' subsection immediately before the cells-add invocation instructions (the `.bee/bin/bee cells add --stdin` heredoc around lines 188-198): a numbered checklist the planner walks BEFORE drafting cells — (1) ids match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$ and follow the <feature-slug-abbrev>-<n> convention, and collide with no existing cell id (list existing ids first: `bee cells list`); (2) required non-empty string fields: id, feature, title, action, verify — and verify "none" is legal only in a repo whose commands.test declares itself no-test; (3) lane is one of tiny|small|standard|high-risk|spike, and standard/high-risk cells carry non-empty must_haves.truths; (4) scope-derived obligations: any files path under a release-manifest or onboarding-ledger root obliges the verify command to carry `bee dev release-manifest --check`, the files list to carry the manifest record, and the cell to run the regen chain (`bee dev regen`) — or a reasoned regen_obligation_ack (recognized value "wave-barrier" defers to wave close); a guard-source path on a lane below standard obliges judge_obligation_ack or a raised lane; (5) deps acyclic, current slice only, feature's execution gate approved. Close the subsection with the mandate: pipe the drafted batch through `bee cells add --stdin --dry-run` and run the real add only after a clean dry-run — a dirty dry-run's problems list is the fix list, applied before anything persists; the validator stays the source of truth, the checklist is the map to it. State the id convention as prose (today it exists only by example). In skills/bee-planning/SKILL.md 'Prep' section, extend the cells-add sentence to name pre-flight + dry-run with a pointer to the new subsection. In skills/bee-hive/references/routing-and-contracts.md tiny/small fast path (lines ~167-169), add that draft cells previewed in the gate message are dry-run-validated first. Match the register and density of surrounding text; keep the checklist under ~20 lines. Then run the full regen chain /home/thanhsmind/projects/goglbe/beehive--wt--cell-preflight/.bee/bin/bee dev regen (render-skill-trees, then onboard --repo-root . --apply, then release-manifest --write, in that order — REGEN_OBLIGATION for touching skills/) and commit everything as one commit.
